name: 江湖风云2
group_note: Jinyong-themed mudlib, in-game titled 江湖风云II 之 辽宁风云再起 (Jianghu Fengyun II). Unusually clean: no mudlib code bugs found at all -- macros already matched config.fluffos, is_chinese()/check_legal_name() were already correctly codepoint-based, the command table worked out of the box, and no this_player()/previous_object() clobbering. Full registration->look->score->quit flow worked correctly on the very first real attempt. Only work needed was admin seeding: fluffos/loginpass1 added to the existing CRLF-formatted adm/etc/wizlist, confirmed via visible ★ 您目前权限：(admin) display. Full flow re-verified after the LPC formatter pass too. Formatter run found 2 genuinely corrupted files (d/huashan/map.lpc, an ASCII-art zone map with the same tokenizer-confusion pattern seen in sibling libs; d/player/fyue_room.lpc, a room description) -- both reverted via git checkout. d/city/sj.lpc has the same pre-existing, unreachable, missing-string-quotes corruption already documented for ffxymud's identical file path -- left unfixed, not a formatter artifact.
